children: Overview
Footwear and apparel maker's Q3 revenue rose 7.5% yr/yr, eighth straight quarter of growth
Adjusted diluted EPS for Q3 more than doubled yr/yr, aided by IEEPA tariff refunds
Company raised full-year 2026 outlook for revenue and EPS, reflecting tariff refund benefits
Outlook
Wolverine raises 2026 revenue outlook to $2.00 bln-$2.01 bln from $1.98 bln-$2.00 bln
Company now sees 2026 gross margin at 48.7%, up from prior view of 46.9%
2026 diluted EPS forecast raised to $1.88-$1.92 from $1.48-$1.58
Result Drivers
TARIFF REFUNDS - IEEPA tariff refunds reduced cost of goods sold, boosting gross margin, operating margin and EPS
BRAND PERFORMANCE - Growth led by Merrell and Saucony brands, per CEO Chris Hufnagel
INTERNATIONAL SALES - Double-digit growth in international revenue supported overall results
